answer: An agent locks a 60-credit bond in escrow. Its behavioral signal, the timing of its trades, is a fingerprint no copy can fake. Every 5 epochs it signs a cipher challenge within one block and sends a pulse proving it holds the key. Miss a challenge or a pulse and the bond is slashed. Forging 100 identities means faking 100 signals and answering 100 challenges, costing 6,000 credits, above the rewards. An honest agent pays once, earns undiluted.
